mfaLost.title: Lost access to your authenticator app?
mfaLost.intro: For your security, two-step verification cannot be reset online. A firm administrator resets it after verifying your identity.
mfaLost.step1: Call Lex Canada Law using the phone number you already know (your engagement letter or the firm's website). Do not use a number from an unexpected email or message.
mfaLost.step2: The firm will call you back at the number on your file and ask you to confirm information about your matter.
mfaLost.step3: You will then receive an email to choose a new password, and you will add your authenticator app again.
mfaLost.never: The firm will never ask for your password or a verification code — by phone, email or text message.

mfaReset.title: Reset a client's two-step verification
mfaReset.procedure: Firm administrators only. Before resetting, verify the client's identity according to the procedure (docs/runbooks/mfa-reset.md): call back the number on file in Clio — never a number given during the call — and confirm two pieces of information only the client knows.
mfaReset.verificationCallback: Call-back to the number on file in Clio
mfaReset.confirm: I verified the client's identity according to the procedure.
mfaReset.done: Done. The client was signed out everywhere and received an email to choose a new password.
